scope: stop current heldout safe replacement route; protocol and read-only API/source inspection only; no implementation, solver calls, experiments, Stage7B, commit or push

cache_lock.canonicalization: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(relative_path_to_file_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); paths relative to cache root; include bundle.json,input_hashes.json,implementation.json,features/*/{features.npz,record.json},main/{46 declared case_ids}/{B,C}/{matches.npz,record.json}

input.intrinsics: known distortion-free K_processed=A*K_original; retain skew; zero-based pixel centers; no new preprocessing
input.row_order: original lexicographic match indices; preserve all aliases, scores unused; no filtering, deduplication, PROSAC sorting or GT selection

old.normalization: existing float64 full K inverse; fbar=mean(fx1,fy1,fx2,fy2)

new.name: USAC MAGSAC score + sigma-consensus LO, preset-matched seeded parameter interface
new.python_call_contract: findEssentialMat(p,q,K1,K2,None,None,params) -> E,mask; first two matrices are K1,K2, followed by both distortion slots
new.input: contiguous float64 copies of original cached pixels and original full K1/K2; no external normalization or pixel offset
new.threshold_semantics: API unsquared 1.5 processed pixels -> internal tau=1.5/fbar, squared Sampson threshold tau^2; not literal per-pixel equivalence for unequal fx/fy
new.upstream_scales: ESSENTIAL default maximum threshold 2; max_thr=min(max(1.5,2)/fbar,10*tau); score max_thr=2/fbar here; sigma weights additionally use internal maximum-threshold setting; do not override or relabel all internal scales as tau
new.precision: upstream merge/calibration and Sampson evaluation use float32 internally; legacy path differs; compare whole E-estimator package, not scoring alone
new.final_polisher: source setParameters(UsacParams) does not forward final_polisher or final_polisher_iterations; do not set them or claim control; ModelImpl MAGSAC polisher and final_lsq_iters=7 remain upstream behavior

backend.H_and_downstream: unchanged pixel-space H RANSAC with RNG reset to seed; original minimum counts, H/E ambiguity gate, four pose hypotheses, DLT, depth, parallax and reprojection checks; native E mask used without harmonization

runtime_lock.provenance_limit: installed build says 5.0.0-dirty; upstream submodule source correspondence is not a byte-for-byte proof of wheel C++ source; synthetic runtime contract checks are mandatory after separate authorization

execution_plan.case_order: scan ascending; sharp,spaced,blur; view IDs ascending as inherited case list
execution_plan.rotation: case index modulo 4; seeds ascending within each arm; serial execution
execution_plan.old_reproduction: before releasing quality evaluation, compare every old arm/seed to historical full-fit status/reason, exact masks/counts and accepted R/t atol=1e-9 rtol=0; mismatch => BLOCKED, no baseline repair or replacement
execution_plan.truth_boundary: worker sees only sanitized matches,K,parameters; deny GT,prior poses,evaluations and network; evaluate all saved outputs in separate process afterward

metrics.primary: per-object macro joint AUC@10; four conditions equal weight, seeds equal weight; reduced3 reuses normal5 results
secondary: correct initialization: accepted and both rotation and directed translation <=5 degrees
false acceptance: accepted and joint=max(rotation,directed translation)>5 degrees
paired rescues, correct-to-wrong or rejected transitions, new false accepts, severe joint error>20 degrees
E/H counts, rejection reason, triangulation support; GT epipolar consistency only a proxy
geometry-only wall time,RSS and preparation/IO/session totals
metrics.denominator: all 46 cases x 4 arms x 3 seeds retained; rejected/resource/unknown contribute zero AUC and zero correct; unknown truth never counted as false or safe
metrics.forbidden_claims: no hybrid output, learned safe selector, statistical independence of pairs/seeds, blind validation, dense quality improvement or algorithm novelty

continue_gates.G1: C_new vs C_old: per-object macro AUC@10 strictly higher; per-object macro correct rate nondecreasing; deduplicated stable correct count difference >=2 overall and >=1 in each object; stable correct means all three seeds correct; report partial-seed transitions separately
continue_gates.G2: C_new vs both C_old and B_old: per-object/per-seed total false accepts nonincreasing; every normal5 pair correct in all baseline seeds remains correct in all candidate seeds; no new >20 degree accepted error at any pair/seed where either baseline was correct or rejected
continue_gates.G3: C_new vs B_old: per-object macro AUC@10 and macro correct rate nondecreasing; deduplicated net stable correct count strictly higher overall
continue_gates.G4: seed42 paired C_new-C_old complete geometry wall time: median <=1 s and p95 <=3 s (linear quantile); report both B backend costs too; no speed claim from one sample
continue_gates.G5: all planned rows, input/source/runtime locks, future synthetic API contracts and old reproduction pass; no resource failures or key truth unknown

stop_conditions: any valid complete quality gate fails => NO_GO_EVIDENCE; no alternate thresholds/estimators/seed selection or exception rules
cost gate fails => NO_GO_COST; resource failure => NO_GO_RESOURCE; incomplete quality remains unestablished
API unsupported, source/runtime drift, source semantic contract failure or old reproduction mismatch => BLOCKED, preserve records and seek amendment; never switch to F fitting or method flag silently
external interruption/key GT undefined => INCONCLUSIVE; unknown is not a prevented failure
passing all gates => GO_FEASIBILITY only, proposal for separately authorized unseen-object confirmation; no Stage7B or stability/novelty claim

budget.failure_policy: no same-case parameter retry; retain failures and unexecuted rows; fresh output directory refuses overwrite

focus_evidence: retain original seven benefits, six new false accepts including two normal regressions, all four heldout harms, and 12 heldout unknown cases; labels offline only, never skip or tune by them
